node.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one base-field branch exclusion
node.statement: The complete t in F_p branch of the m=8,h=7 order-one conic is empty. On the two residual rows, P^[p](W)=-P(1-W), so every root x has both x and 1-x in mu_n. Their p+1 colors reduce from mu_8 to three surviving real color pairs, giving at most six possible roots, while the degree-seven divisor P has seven distinct roots.
node.notes: Complete proof close of one h=7 branch. The non-base-field conic parameter and every other declared L1 chamber remain open.
